verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Ask AI answers natural-language questions over the inbox without the user recalling senders or keywords, and supports follow-up questions. Separately, the Mail MCP connects inbox and calendar to Claude and ChatGPT so an external assistant can work across both. missing for 10: documented source citations or links that ground each answer, explicit evidence that Ask AI itself queries the calendar or surfaces outstanding items on request, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: You can now get rapid answers without having to remember senders, guess keywords, or comb through messages.
You can ask follow-up questions in a conversation.

Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.
You can create powerful workflows that run across your inbox and calendar
